title: Drupal Forge template setup
---

Follow the [template setup guide](https://drupalforge.github.io/template-setup.html).
Check off tasks in this issue as you complete them. Do not include secrets.

## Prepare the repository

- [ ] Create a repository from the starter template.
- [ ] Choose the Composer project or add your own `composer.json`.
- [ ] Customize the example README.
- [ ] Run the app and confirm that it installs.

## Publish a quick start image (optional)

- [ ] Add a Docker build workflow.
- [ ] Configure the Docker Hub variable and secret, and any required
  initialization secrets.
- [ ] Run the workflow and confirm that the image is published to Docker Hub.
